about: Rules for tools/bangla_plain_apply.mjs. Binding source: docs/design/bangla-plain-final-decision.md. Word rules run first (in order), then per-key rewrites of the same group. Edits touch Bangla string values only.

protected.about: Protected strings accept only the 'spelling' group (plus rules/rewrites marked allowProtected). Keys are packs.ts keys (regex). contentRegex matches any string, in any file.
